name: Atlas
source: Atlas is the Prince and heir to the throne of Terran. He has been mentored by King Lucius for over two thousand years and for the last four hundred years has been ruling in all but name. Atlas has a very strategic mind and can make difficult choices making him a great leader. He cares deeply about those close to him and his people however he can be unsympathetic to those he doesn't regard and is known for holding grudges. He's also a bit of a clean freak.
